# Migrations (Alembic)

Alembic is configured for async SQLAlchemy. The database URL and target
metadata are sourced from the application settings (see `env.py`), so migrations
use the same configuration as the running service.

Common commands (run from the repository root):

```bash
# Apply all migrations
alembic upgrade head

# Create a new autogenerated migration after adding/changing models
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "add incidents table"

# Roll back one revision
alembic downgrade -1

# Show current revision / history
alembic current
alembic history
```

When new model modules are added, import them in `env.py` so autogenerate can
detect their tables.
